weather.note: ★ **今天（10/21，週三）東北季風增強，北部與宜蘭明顯轉涼轉濕。****新竹以北及東北部有局部短暫陣雨**，花東與恆春半島零星陣雨，中南部仍多雲到晴。**氣溫**：桃園以北及宜蘭高溫只有 **27–30°C**（比昨天驟降 4–5 度）、新竹以南及花東 **31–34°C**、澎湖 29°C、金門 31°C、馬祖 27°C；全台低溫 **22–26°C**。**今天一定要帶薄外套＋傘。**　★ 清晨彰化到台南易有局部霧或低雲，能見度差，**騎車上課放慢**。　★★ **強颱「薔琵」最新時程（這是本週唯一需要你提前動作的一件事）**：今晨 **02 時**中心位於北緯 **17.4 度**、東經 **131.4 度**，以每小時 **20 公里**向西北西移動；近中心最大風速 **60 m/s**、瞬間陣風 **75 m/s**，**七級風暴風半徑 280 公里、十級風 120 公里**。預計 **22 日**在石垣島附近開始北轉，北轉後因海溫下降與東北季風影響強度稍減，**以強颱下限或中颱上限之姿影響台灣**。　★ **警報時程**：**海上警報最快今晚（10/21）深夜～10/22 白天發布**；**陸上警報不排除 10/22 晚間～10/23 發布**，警戒範圍以北部與東半部為主。　★ **120 小時暴風侵襲機率（氣象署）**：基隆市、宜蘭縣 **逾 7 成**；台北、新北 **逾 6 成**；桃園 **逾 5 成**。　★ **風雨最劇：10/23（五）下半天 ～ 10/24（六）上半天**，北部、宜蘭、花蓮有局部大雨或豪雨；風雨要到 **10/24 中午過後**才逐漸減弱。10/23 東南部位於背風側，**可能出現焚風**。　★ **長浪**：基隆北海岸、東半部、馬祖自 **10/22 起至 10/25** 都有長浪，中部與澎湖沿海 10/22–23 也可能有 —— **這幾天不要去海邊、不要去堤防**。　★ **今天該做的三件實體準備**：①手電筒、電池、行動電源充飽；②飲用水與不需加熱的食物備兩天份；③陽台花盆、曬衣架、腳踏車等懸掛物收進室內。**不要等到週五。**　★ 10/23（五）北北基桃是否放颱風假目前仍未定，但已有「有望連放四天」的討論 —— **不要把不能改期的事排在週五。**

items.kind: 不需要動作：這是工科系要清掉舊設備、對校內各單位發的認領公告，**對象是有實驗室空間的老師與單位，不是大學部學生**。直接已讀。
items.detail: ★ 原信：工程科學系有一組**鋁擠型置物架**與一組**不鏽鋼抽氣櫃（fume hood，抽氣／排煙櫃）**可供認領，因出口位置與電梯限制**無法直接搬運**，需認領者自行聯絡協力廠商處理搬運。聯絡人：工科系劉先生，分機 **63307**，liupc@ncku.edu.tw。　★ **唯一有價值的一點**：如果你之後進實驗室做專題、而指導教授正在缺**抽氣櫃（fume hood）**，這類校內設備轉讓訊息其實是撿便宜的管道 —— **但這要由老師或實驗室名義認領，學生個人不會是對象。** 今天就當作資訊性信件略過。　★ **用詞小筆記**：**fume hood（抽氣櫃／排煙櫃）** = 化工與化學實驗室用來排除有毒蒸氣、粉塵的通風設備，是你之後進實驗室第一天就會碰到的東西。

items.en: Trump says "it's time for somebody else to negotiate" for Ukraine as Zelensky runs out of Patriot interceptors
items.zh: **川普公開要求換掉澤倫斯基當談判代表** —— 烏克蘭 Patriot 攔截彈幾乎用盡，澤倫斯基赴挪威見威特科夫，願以 30 天停打俄國煉油廠換攔截彈
items.summary: President Trump told reporters that "it's time for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine," blaming President Zelenskyy for failing to reach a deal sooner. Zelenskyy says Ukraine has nearly exhausted its stock of US-made Patriot interceptors, leaving cities exposed to Russian missile barrages. He travelled to Norway to meet US envoy Steve Witkoff and offered a 30-day pause on Ukrainian strikes against Russian oil refineries in exchange for more interceptors. Overnight Russian drone and missile attacks killed at least four civilians across Ukraine.

items.en: Finland to buy one million anti-personnel landmines for over $100 million after quitting the Mine Ban Treaty
items.zh: **芬蘭宣布採購 100 萬枚反步兵地雷、金額逾 1 億美元** —— 今年 1 月退出《禁雷公約》後的首筆大單，國際禁雷運動要求撤回
items.summary: Finland announced it will purchase one million anti-personnel landmines at a cost of more than one hundred million dollars, following its withdrawal from the Mine Ban Treaty in January. The International Campaign to Ban Landmines urged Finland and other states to reverse course, warning the weapons kill civilians for decades after conflicts end. Finland shares a long border with Russia and frames the purchase as deterrence. Separately, a Russian satellite was reported manoeuvring close to a Finnish-American radar satellite used by Ukraine's military.

items.en: Drone strike near a market in Sudan's West Kordofan kills 80 people, among the deadliest single attacks of the war
items.zh: **蘇丹西科爾多凡市集遭無人機襲擊、80 人死亡** —— 開戰以來最血腥的單次攻擊之一，雙方互相指責，累計逾 1,300 萬人流離失所
items.summary: A drone strike near a market in Sudan's West Kordofan state killed eighty people on Sunday, making it one of the deadliest single attacks since the war began in April 2023. The paramilitary Rapid Support Forces blamed the Sudanese Armed Forces, which denied responsibility. Markets have repeatedly been hit in the conflict, and aid agencies say access to the region remains severely restricted. More than thirteen million people have now been displaced, in what the UN describes as the world's largest displacement crisis.

items.en: Brazil's Electoral Court gives Meta 24 hours to prove it treats both campaigns equally before Sunday's presidential runoff
items.zh: **巴西選舉法院給 Meta 24 小時自證公平** —— 聖保羅民眾包圍 Meta 辦公室抗議干預選舉，週日魯拉對決小波索納洛
items.summary: Protesters rallied outside Meta's offices in São Paulo accusing the company of electoral interference ahead of Sunday's presidential runoff between incumbent President Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Brazil's Electoral Court gave Meta twenty-four hours to demonstrate that it applies its advertising and moderation rules equally to both campaigns. The dispute echoes earlier Brazilian clashes with US platforms over disinformation. A ruling against Meta could force changes to political advertising on Facebook and Instagram days before voting.

items.en: Seventh person dies in ICE custody in Texas this year; family says heart and diabetes medication was withheld
items.zh: **德州今年第 7 名移民拘留所死亡案** —— 56 歲合法永久居民安德拉德-科瓦魯比亞斯在 GEO Group 設施中被發現失去意識，家屬稱藥物被拒給
items.summary: Emiliano Andrade-Covarrubias, a fifty-six-year-old lawful permanent resident, was found unresponsive at a GEO Group-run immigration detention centre in Laredo, Texas. His family says he was denied his heart and diabetes medications while detained. He is the seventh person to die in ICE custody in Texas this year, a figure advocates call unprecedented. In a separate incident in Long Beach, California, video shows ICE agents kneeling on former city employee Ricardo Gonzalez during a protest, breaking his arm.

items.en: Anthropic's draft S-1 reportedly shows $16.3B first-half revenue, an $80.7B net loss, and a $518B compute commitment
items.zh: **Anthropic 傳遞交 IPO 草案、目標 11 月上市估值約 2 兆美元** —— 上半年營收 163 億美元、淨虧 807 億（多為非現金），兩個未具名客戶佔營收約 25%
items.summary: Reports on Anthropic's draft S-1 filing describe sixteen point three billion dollars of revenue in the first half of 2026 against an eighty point seven billion dollar net loss that is said to be mostly non-cash. Roughly a quarter of revenue reportedly comes from just two unnamed customers, a concentration risk investors will scrutinise. The company has committed about five hundred and eighteen billion dollars to compute over roughly a decade and is said to target a two trillion dollar valuation in a November listing. Figures remain unconfirmed by Anthropic.
items.source: Artificially Intimidating / AI Weekly — AI News, October 20, 2026（★ 此為媒體轉述未經公司確認的草案數字，請以正式公開文件為準）

items.en: OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol scores 97.9% on its COBOL migration eval, up from 5.4% for the previous model
items.zh: **OpenAI 宣稱新模型把 COBOL 遷移正確率從 5.4% 拉到 97.9%** —— 針對銀行與 ATM 的半世紀老程式碼，但測驗由 OpenAI 自己出題自己評分
items.summary: OpenAI reports that GPT-6.1 Sol reaches ninety-seven point nine percent on its internal COBOL migration evaluation at maximum reasoning effort, against five point four percent for GPT-5.6 Sol, and eighty-six point six percent at low effort for roughly sixty-one percent less cost. On MultiLangBench, GPT-6 Astra averages eighty-seven point four percent across twenty languages, up from twenty-six point eight. OpenAI notes COBOL underpins over forty percent of online banking and ninety-five percent of ATM transactions. The company wrote and graded both benchmarks itself.

items.en: Google open-sources TorchTPU and proposes a 780MW AI data centre in Pine Island, Minnesota
items.zh: **Google 開源 TorchTPU，讓 PyTorch 幾乎不改程式就能跑 TPU** —— 同日提出明尼蘇達 780MW AI 資料中心，並承諾為電網出資 1,400MW 風電、200MW 太陽能、300MW 儲能
items.summary: Google released TorchTPU, an open-source PyTorch variant that runs on its own TPUs with minimal code changes, alongside a TPU agent suite that helps developers port applications and fix errors, and an updated LiteRT for mobile and embedded devices. The launch landed a day after Amazon's TorchNeuron release for AWS Trainium, underlining how aggressively both firms are courting PyTorch developers away from CUDA. Google separately proposed a seven hundred and eighty megawatt data centre in Pine Island, Minnesota, financing 1,400MW of wind, 200MW of solar and 300MW of storage.
items.source: AI Weekly — AI News Today, October 20, 2026

items.en: Wei Chuan Dragons shut out CTBC Brothers 6-0 to take a 3-0 lead in the Taiwan Series; Game 4 is tonight
items.zh: **台灣大賽 G3 味全龍 6:0 完封中信兄弟、3 連勝聽牌** —— 兄弟三場打擊率 0.100 寫下隊史最慘，今晚 G4 龍隊就能封王
items.summary: The Wei Chuan Dragons shut out the CTBC Brothers six to nothing in Game 3 of the Taiwan Series at Taipei Dome on Monday night, taking a commanding three games to none series lead. The Brothers managed just one hit and are batting a dismal .100 across the three games, the worst mark in the franchise's Taiwan Series history. Dragons manager Yeh Chun-chang said he never expected to be one win away this quickly. Game 4 is tonight, with the Dragons able to clinch the championship.
items.source: 鏡週刊 Mirror Media／壹蘋新聞網 — 2026/10/20

items.en: Tampa Bay Rays beat Cleveland 7-3 in ALCS Game 6 and will face the Milwaukee Brewers in the World Series from Friday
items.zh: **光芒 7:3 收下美聯冠軍賽第六戰、隊史第三次闖進世界大賽** —— 卡米內羅與迪亞茲各扛兩分砲，週五在密爾瓦基與釀酒人開打
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays beat the Cleveland Guardians seven to three in Game 6 of the American League Championship Series at Tropicana Field, closing out the series in six games with a third straight win. Junior Caminero and Yandy Diaz each hit a two-run homer, with Diaz's eighth-inning blast restoring a four-run cushion. It is the Rays' third World Series appearance in franchise history. They will face the Milwaukee Brewers, with Game 1 scheduled for Friday in Milwaukee.

items.en: NBA 2026-27 season tips off with a Western Conference Finals rematch: Thunder at Spurs
items.zh: **NBA 新球季今天開打，首戰就是西區冠軍賽重演** —— 雷霆作客馬刺（台灣時間今天 09:30），同日三場開幕戰
items.summary: The 2026-27 NBA season opens with a nationally televised Western Conference Finals rematch as the Oklahoma City Thunder visit the San Antonio Spurs at Frost Bank Center, tipping off at 9:30pm Eastern on Tuesday, which is 9:30am Taipei time on Wednesday. The league scheduled three games for opening night. The Spurs-Thunder matchup headlines what broadcasters are selling as the most promising young rivalry in the Western Conference, after the two met in last season's conference finals.
items.source: NBA.com／News 4 San Antonio — 2026 NBA opening night

items.en: Your body's physiological state may shape whether your best ideas arrive as words or as images
items.zh: **身體狀態會決定你的好想法是「文字型」還是「圖像型」** —— 對正在排讀書計畫的你很實用：換個生理狀態，可能換到另一種思考模式
items.summary: New research in cognitive science suggests a person's bodily and physiological state may influence whether their best ideas surface in verbal or visual form. The finding fits a broader embodied cognition literature arguing that thinking is not purely abstract but shaped by bodily signals such as arousal, posture and interoceptive state. If replicated, the practical implication is that switching physical state, through movement, rest or changed environment, could shift which representational mode of problem solving comes most easily during study or revision.

items.en: A larger paycheck tends to come with measurable personality changes, a large-scale analysis of psychology research finds
items.zh: **薪水變高，人格也會跟著變** —— 大規模整合分析發現收入上升與人格特質改變有系統性關聯，不只是「有錢人本來就這樣」
items.summary: A large-scale analysis of psychology research reports that rising income is systematically associated with shifts in personality traits, rather than simply reflecting pre-existing differences between rich and poor people. The direction of causation remains the central open question, since personality also predicts earnings. For students planning careers, the finding is a reminder that occupational and financial trajectories may reshape dispositions over time. The authors call for longitudinal designs that track the same individuals as their earnings change.

items.en: Online meat-shaming appears to do little to change minds, new research suggests
items.zh: **網路上公開羞辱吃肉的人，幾乎改變不了任何人的想法** —— 道德心理學研究再次指出，羞辱式說服對態度轉變無效甚至反效果
items.summary: New moral psychology research suggests that publicly shaming people online over meat consumption does little to shift their attitudes. The result aligns with a wider literature showing that shame-based persuasion often triggers defensiveness and identity protection rather than genuine attitude change, and can harden the position being targeted. The study matters beyond diet debates, since the same dynamic appears in online argument about climate, public health and politics, where moralised criticism is the default rhetorical move.

items.en: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent reportedly ordered over 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 cards worth more than $35B — more than Nvidia can build
items.zh: **中國三巨頭傳下單超過 300 萬張 Nvidia RTX PRO 5500、金額逾 350 億美元** —— 但 Nvidia 告知夥伴 2027 年最多只能做 300 萬顆，客戶可能只拿到 5–10%
items.summary: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have reportedly placed orders for more than three million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 cards worth over thirty-five billion dollars. Nvidia has told partners it can manufacture no more than three million of these chips during 2027, meaning individual customers may receive only five to ten percent of what they requested. The gap illustrates how acute AI accelerator scarcity has become even for export-compliant parts. Separately, OpenAI has reportedly dropped its push for strict US chip export controls on China after Nvidia took a thirty billion dollar equity stake.
items.source: AI Weekly — AI News Today, October 20, 2026

items.en: SK hynix targets January 2027 for an HBF standard and shows DRAM stacked directly on AI processor dies, as its shares post their worst week since 2008
items.zh: **SK 海力士拚 2027 年 1 月定出 HBF 標準，並展示直接疊在運算晶片上的 3D DRAM** —— 同時其股價寫下 2008 年以來最慘一週，記憶體題材正處「技術大躍進、股價先修正」的落差
items.summary: SK hynix is targeting January 2027 for a High Bandwidth Flash standard and has shown a memory tier above HBM in which 3D stacked DRAM mounts directly onto processor dies, aimed at AI inference capacity. Samsung and SK hynix both showcased zHBM and HBF concepts at SEDEX 2026 as the industry attacks the AI memory bottleneck. SK hynix holds roughly sixty-two percent of the HBM market, with Micron now ahead of Samsung, and the 2026 battle pivoting to HBM4. The stock nonetheless logged its worst week since 2008.

items.en: Nvidia signs a physical-AI pact with the German government, while Jim Keller's Tenstorrent raises $1.5B at a $6.2B valuation
items.zh: **Nvidia 與德國政府簽署「實體 AI」合作宣言、黃仁勳稱德國工廠資料是「天然資源」** —— 同時 Jim Keller 的 Tenstorrent 完成 15 億美元 E 輪、投後估值 62 億，AI 晶片挑戰者資金仍在湧入
items.summary: At the Invest in Germany Summit in Berlin, Chancellor Friedrich Merz and two federal ministries signed a Joint Declaration of Intent with Nvidia to develop AI models for physical AI covering robotics, manufacturing and vehicles. Jensen Huang urged German carmakers and machine builders to adopt AI quickly, calling the country's factory data a natural resource, in an economy that has barely grown since the pandemic. Separately Jim Keller's Tenstorrent raised a one point five billion dollar Series E at a six point two billion post-money valuation. No major quantum computing news appeared in the window.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu announces his largest-ever world tour "GHOST" — 11 cities, 14 shows, including two nights at Taipei Dome on December 26-27
items.zh: **米津玄師宣布生涯最大規模世界巡演「GHOST」，首站就是台北大巨蛋 12/26–12/27 兩天** —— 距今約 2 個月，這是你清單內歌手今年最大的台灣場，請務必盯票
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu announced GHOST, his largest world tour to date, covering eleven cities and fourteen shows from December 26, 2026 to February 28, 2027, with total attendance projected around two hundred thousand. Asia gets three cities: Taipei Dome for two nights on December 26 and 27, Seoul for three nights, and Singapore. North America covers Oakland, Los Angeles, Mexico City, New York/Newark and Toronto; Europe covers London, Paris and Amsterdam. The tour follows Chainsaw Man theme song IRIS OUT, which set the all-time weekly streaming record in Japan.
items.source: アニメ！アニメ！／音楽ナタリー — 2026/10/15 · 🎧 Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/%E7%B1%B3%E6%B4%A5%E7%8E%84%E5%B8%AB

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour opens at Kaohsiung National Stadium on October 31 — ten days away, and sold out
items.zh: **藤井風高雄國家體育場就在 10 天後（10/31），門票已完售** —— Prema World Tour 全球首站獻給台灣，之後接曼谷 12/26、首爾 2027/1/9，香港場取消
items.summary: Fujii Kaze opens his Prema World Tour at Kaohsiung National Stadium on October 31, 2026, the tour's only Taiwan date and now ten days away, with tickets sold out. The world tour's opening night being given to Taiwan drew significant local coverage. Later stops include Bangkok's Supachalasai National Stadium on December 26 and Seoul's Gocheok Sky Dome on January 9, 2027, while the Hong Kong show was cancelled. Japanese dome legs follow at Fukuoka, Osaka and Tokyo Dome between November and December.
items.source: Blow 吹音樂／Bella／Yahoo 新聞 — 藤井風 Prema World Tour 高雄場 · 🎧 Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/Fujii%20Kaze%20%E8%97%A4%E4%BA%95%E9%A2%A8

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's first gelato pique collaboration goes on sale, as new song "Damashi" fronts an anan cover story
items.zh: **Mrs. GREEN APPLE × gelato pique 聯名系列昨天（10/20）開賣** —— 全日本門市與線上同步，另有青蘋果原創角色；新曲「瞞し」同期登上《anan》封面特輯
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's first collaboration with loungewear brand gelato pique, titled Mrs. GREEN APPLE with GELATO PIQUE, went on sale on October 20, 2026 at gelato pique stores nationwide in Japan and through its online store, accompanied by an original green-apple character. In the same period the band fronted an anan cover story built around new song Damashi, surprise-released an MV described as unbroadcastable on terrestrial television, and became the first Japanese act to have YouTube turn its progress bar green-apple coloured.

items.en: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026 is the band's largest ever, with first-time stops in Bangkok and Hong Kong
items.zh: **King Gnu「CEN+RAL Tour 2026」是樂團史上最多都市、最多場次的巡演** —— 15–16 都市、29 公演，首度加入曼谷與香港；台灣場次尚未公布，香港場是最近的選項
items.summary: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026 is billed as the largest tour in the band's history, spanning fifteen to sixteen cities and twenty-nine performances after an added Yokohama date, and including first-ever shows in Niigata, Bangkok and Hong Kong. No Taiwan date has been announced, which makes the Hong Kong show the nearest option for Taiwan-based fans. The tour final is scheduled for a live stream on Lemino, with WOWOW also carrying broadcast coverage, so the shows will be watchable without travelling.

market.asOf: 台股＝**2026/10/20（二）13:30 收盤**；美股＝**2026/10/20（二）正規盤收盤**（台灣今天 10/21 清晨 04:00 結束）。　★★ **今天這一區最重要的一句話：台股昨天又崩 529 點、外資連 10 個交易日賣超再砍 795 億；但美股昨晚道瓊 +1.02%、羅素 2000 +1.65%、醫療類股創歷史新高，那斯達克卻只有 -0.02%、META 連五跌 —— 錢沒走，是從 AI 大型股輪動到價值股與小型股。所以今天台股開盤要問的不是「美股漲不漲」，而是「這波輪動會不會讓台股電子繼續被抽血」。**
market.note: ★ **今天（10/21，週三）開盤前只盯這三件，其他先放掉**：　**①「輪動」不是「反彈」，別把道瓊 +1.02% 當成利多。**昨晚美股的結構非常清楚：醫療 +2.2%（歷史新高）、小型股 +1.65%、金融 +1.1%，但科技與通訊平盤、半導體只 +0.3%、META 連五跌。**對台股這種電子權重超過六成的市場，這種輪動等於沒有救援。**今天台股若開高，重點是**開高能不能守住**，而不是開高幾點。　**②外資連 10 賣、累計 8,380 億，這是本波最硬的壓力。**昨天再賣 795.4 億，三大法人合計賣超 968 億，而投信連 8 買只買了 183 億 —— **內資的買盤規模完全不足以對沖外資提款。**量能同步縮到 7,586 億，**縮量下跌代表買方還沒回來，不要急著接刀。**　**③昨天殺最凶的是金融（-2.36%），不是電子。**這跟前幾天的記憶體殺盤是不同的故事：金融股受的是**匯率與殖利率**的壓力（美債 10 年期 5.11%、2 年期 4.76%、新台幣貶值壓力），而你的觀察清單裡有 **富邦金、國泰金、中信金、玉山金、兆豐金** 五檔金融防禦股 —— **「防禦股」在升息＋匯率波動的環境裡並不防禦，這點請務必記住。**　★ **記憶體族群昨天反而止穩**：族群指數盤中 -2.89%，南亞科盤中 -3.67%、旺宏 -1.47%、華邦電 -1.29%，**跌幅明顯小於前一天的 -6% 級盤中殺盤**。而 **SK 海力士剛寫下 2008 年以來最慘一週**、美光則宣布投資美國關鍵礦物加工 —— **技術面（HBF 標準、3D 疊 DRAM）在大躍進，股價卻在修正，這個落差值得你持續追蹤而不是當天殺進殺出。**　★ **被動元件昨天逆勢轉強**：**禾伸堂（3026）盤中一度漲停至 808 元**，聚鼎（6224）、鈺凱（5228）也一度漲停 —— 與前一天「華新科、禾伸堂盤中 -9%」完全反向，**這類急殺急拉的族群不在你的觀察清單內，當作市場情緒溫度計看就好。**　★ **本週行事曆上的市場事件**：**META 財報今天（10/21）美股盤後**、Netflix 與 SpaceX 財報已於 10/20 盤後公布；9 月新屋開工 **122.1 萬戶**低於預期、待完成房屋銷售月減 **7.3%** —— 房市走弱是昨晚小型股與公用事業上漲（押注降息）的主要理由。　★★ **注意：10/23（五）～10/24（六）颱風薔琵風雨最劇，若週五北北基桃停班，台股會休市 —— 本週交易日可能只有四天（10/20、10/21、10/22 加上不確定的 10/23）。**

indices.note: 10/20 收盤 · **跌 6.17 點、-1.57%**，跌幅明顯大於加權 —— **中小型股殺得比權值股凶，代表散戶與投機資金在撤。**

indices.note: ★ **本次未取得 10/20 的確認收盤價與漲跌幅，故不填數字。**0050 追蹤台灣 50 指數，權值高度集中台積電（約四成），參考方向可直接看加權與台積電（台積電 10/20 收 2,405、-0.62%）。**請以券商報價為準。**

indices.name: 元大高股息（0056）
indices.note: ★ **本次未取得 10/20 的確認收盤價與漲跌幅，故不填數字。**0056 為高股息型 ETF，成分偏向金融與傳產，而**昨天金融類股大跌 2.36%** —— 方向上對 0056 不利。**請以券商報價為準。**

indices.name: 那斯達克 Nasdaq Composite
indices.note: 10/20（二）收盤 · **約 -6.07 點、-0.02%，實質平盤。**在道瓊 +1.02%、羅素 2000 +1.65% 的同一天收平盤，**這就是「資金從科技輪出」最直接的證據。**

indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: 10/20 收盤 · **+0.29%**。漲幅主要由醫療（XLV +2.2%，歷史新高）、不動產（+1.7%）、公用事業（+1.3%）、金融（+1.1%）貢獻；科技 XLK 與通訊 XLC 幾乎平盤、能源 -0.4%、工業 -0.2%。

indices.name: 道瓊工業指數 Dow Jones
indices.note: 10/20 收盤 · **+1.02%，約 +530 點**，是昨晚最強的大型指數。**成分偏向金融、醫療、工業等價值股，正好吃到這波輪動** —— 但道瓊走強對台股電子沒有傳導效果。

indices.name: 羅素 2000 Russell 2000
indices.note: 10/20 收盤 · **+1.65%，小型股領漲。**市場解讀是 9 月新屋開工 122.1 萬戶低於預期、待完成房屋銷售月減 7.3%，房市走弱強化降息預期，而**小型股對利率最敏感。**

indices.name: Invesco QQQ（那斯達克100）
indices.note: ★ **那斯達克 100 指數 10/20 幾乎無變動（約 29,532），QQQ 盤中呈平盤**，本次未取得確認的 QQQ 收盤漲跌幅，故不填數字。**請以券商報價為準。**

indices.name: 半導體 SMH（費半替代）
indices.note: ★ **VanEck 半導體 ETF（SMH）10/20 +0.3%，終止九連跌** —— 本次未取得費城半導體指數（SOX）的確認收盤數字，改以 SMH 標示。**+0.3% 只能說是止跌，不是反彈。**

movers.name: ⚠️ 先說清楚今天這一區的資料基準
movers.price: 以下全部是 2026/10/20（二）的收盤／盤中資料；台股今天（10/21）09:00 才開盤
movers.reason: ★ **「≥5%」名單分三層標示**：①**收盤已確認**（交易所級漲跌幅排行）；②**盤中達 ≥5% 但收盤數字未確認**；③**美股為盤中快照（Benzinga 午盤），收盤可能略有差異**。★ **你觀察清單（75 檔）內的標的，10/20 沒有任何一檔漲跌達 ±5%** —— 最大變動是台達電 -2.13% 與 META -2%。**所以以下 ≥5% 名單全部是清單外標的，請當成市場情緒參考，不是建議。**

movers.name: 泰合（清單外·台股漲幅第一）
movers.reason: ★ **+89.57%**，台股 10/20 漲幅冠軍。**單日近九成的漲幅通常來自重大事件（併購、重訊、掛牌相關）而非基本面，波動極端、流動性風險高** —— 列出來是為了讓你知道昨天盤面最極端的一筆，**不是標的推薦。**

movers.name: 芯鼎（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ **+10.0%（漲停）**，影像處理 IC 設計。在 IC 設計族群整體偏弱的一天逆勢漲停，屬個股題材。

movers.name: 台郡（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ **+9.96%（漲停）**，軟板（FPC）大廠、Apple 供應鏈。**與你清單中的 PCB/CCL 族群（台光電、金像電、欣興、華通）屬相鄰題材，可留意是否擴散。**

movers.name: 富威電力（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ **+9.96%（漲停）**，綠電售電與能源管理。**與你清單中台達電的「能源管理」題材同向，但規模與風險差距極大。**

movers.name: 和益（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ **+9.92%（漲停）**，化工股（塑膠原料、化學品）。**對化工系的你有一點產業意義：昨天化工類股裡漲停的是和益，而同一天台塑化卻重摔 -8.19% —— 上游油價高檔與下游需求弱的擠壓，正在讓石化族群內部嚴重分化。**

movers.name: 禾伸堂（清單外·被動元件·僅盤中數據）
movers.price: 盤中一度漲停至 808 元（收盤數字未確認）
movers.reason: ★ **盤中漲停**，與前一天盤中 -9% 完全反向。聚鼎（6224）、鈺凱（5228）同日也一度漲停。法人預估禾伸堂今年 EPS 15 元、明年 35 元。**★ 此為盤中數據，收盤未確認。這種兩天內從 -9% 到漲停的族群，是情緒溫度計，不是投資標的。**

movers.name: 永悅健康-創（清單外·台股跌幅第一）
movers.reason: ★ **-9.54%**，台股 10/20 跌幅冠軍（創新板）。創新板流動性低、波動大。

movers.name: 台塑化（清單外·化工重點）
movers.reason: ★ **-8.19%**，跌幅第二且是大型權值股，**這是昨天最值得化工系學生注意的一筆。**布蘭特原油盤中一度突破 110 美元創五個月新高後翻黑、WTI 約 97.55（-1.0%） —— **原油在高檔而煉油與石化下游需求疲弱，煉油利差（crack spread）被壓縮，這就是台塑化單日重摔的產業邏輯。** 同一天和益卻漲停，石化族群分化極端。**用詞小筆記：crack spread（裂解價差）＝ 原油與其煉製產品之間的價差，是煉油廠獲利的核心指標。**

movers.name: 鼎固-KY（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ **-7.71%**，營建資產股。KY 股（境外註冊）在資金外流環境下通常跌得更快。

movers.name: General Motors（清單外·美股）
movers.reason: ★ **-7.6%**，美股昨天最大的單一股跌幅。**Q3 調整後 EPS 擊敗預期，但全年 EPS 指引低於分析師中位數** —— 典型的「財報好、指引差」殺盤。**這是本週財報季的通用劇本，META 今天盤後財報請用同一個框架看：不是看 Q3 數字，是看指引。★ 此為 Benzinga 午盤快照，收盤數字可能略有差異。**

movers.name: Equifax（清單外·美股漲幅第一）
movers.reason: ★ **+11.4%**，羅素 1000 漲幅第一，信用資料服務。同族群 **TransUnion（TRU）+7.0%** —— **信用資料股大漲同樣是在押注降息（降息→貸款與信用查詢量回升）。★ 盤中快照。**

movers.name: Mueller Industries（清單外·美股跌幅第一）
movers.reason: ★ **-8.8%**，羅素 1000 表現最差，工業金屬加工。★ 盤中快照。

movers.name: 3M／Hasbro（清單外·美股財報受益）
movers.price: MMM 盤中 +5% 以上；HAS 盤中 +5.8%
movers.reason: ★ **3M（MMM）財報後漲逾 5%、Hasbro（HAS）+5.8%** —— 都是典型的「非科技價值股在輪動中受益」。★ 盤中快照。

movers.name: Eli Lilly（★你的觀察清單內·醫療）
movers.price: 創 52 週新高（確認漲幅未取得）
movers.reason: ★ **禮來創 52 週新高，帶領醫療類股（XLV +2.2%）創歷史新高** —— **這是你觀察清單「醫療」分類（LLY／NVO／AMGN）昨晚唯一的大事。**本次未取得 LLY 的確認收盤漲跌幅（盤中約 +5%），**故 change 不填數字，請以券商報價為準。** GLP-1 族群在資金從 AI 輪出時成為主要去處。

movers.name: Meta Platforms（★你的觀察清單內·核心科技）
movers.reason: ★ **-2% 以上、連續第五個交易日下跌**，距 10/13 高點 **771.27** 已低約 **11%**。**★★ 財報就在今天（10/21）美股盤後 —— 這是你清單內本週最重要的單一事件。**參考 GM 的劇本：市場現在懲罰的是**指引**，不是 Q3 數字。
